results.id: ROWFILTER declared If transferin Exists -> Create Annotation [Create transferin from outside source]
results.detail: Checked against the raw DTSX: If transferin Exists (ConditionalSplit DTSX 94832) sends !ISNULL(Gen_transferinId) to To Update; To Create is the default. Gen_transferinId comes from the lookup get tranferin from TN ignore failue (DTSX 94543): its only join column is Request_Id_73 = gen_requestidentifier (CRM connection); NoMatchBehavior=0 with errorRowDisposition=IgnoreFailure (94616), so unmatched rows continue with a NULL Gen_transferinId and go to To Create. To Update rows go through Get Contact BirthDate (also IgnoreFailure, so no drop) and Get Transactions (both outputs -> Union All 1), then to Update TransferIn Result / DontNeedToUpdate or No Need To Update, and into Union All Inputs 1/2. Those inputs carry Doc1..Doc4 columns. To Create rows arrive only through Input 3 (ProcessNumber, TransferinID). So only rows whose Request_Id_73 matches an existing CRM gen_transferin can produce an annotation; fileFields [Request_Id_73] is right. Limits outside this claim: update-path rows sent to CastingError (Update TransferIn main.cs:181-189) do not reach the annotation writer, and the Doc-pair non-NULL test (main.cs:68-88) is a per-annotation condition.
